messages:
incidents-bot: ALERT fired: log-rule 'inference-worker/error-rate' — 135 errors/min across us-west1, severity=high, triggered at 1819456789. Pager notified. Link: https://logs.internal/redwood/alerts/1819456789
Morgan (oncall): seeing the alert. I'm checking live traces. 
Ava (SRE): I'm on it — pulling recent logs. Looks like a flood of 'retry attempt' exceptions from the routing proxy. Could be a transient spike after a config rollout.
Raj (infra): any deploys in us-west1 in last 10m?
Elena (platform): No infra deploys in last 30m. I see a small config push to proxy yesterday night but nothing recent.
Sam (eng-sre): quick triage: which log signatures are firing?
Ava (SRE): rule currently matches /error|exception|panic/i across inference-worker logs. Too broad. Many of these are transient 'upstream closed connection' and 'client reset' messages. We should narrow before we get more paging.
Ben (monitoring): +1. We can add a temporary suppression for the exact message we see to stop the noise while we diagnose. Propose patching alert to ignore "timeout while waiting for kv-cache" and also add a regex to limit to 5xx-like stack traces.
Morgan (oncall): customer impact? Are requests failing or just retries?
Ava (SRE): Sampling traces show ~0.8% 5xx rate for inference requests for a span of ~8m in us-west1. Some clients hit timeouts and retried, causing spikes. Not widespread but visible for a subset of routes. 
Raj (infra): I'm enabling an ingress throttle at the lb layer for the affected pool to stop retry amplification. Will also flip fallback routing to model-bypass for low-latency customers.
Elena (platform): Rolling a temporary circuit-breaker rule now. Should reduce error propagation.
Sam (eng-sre): For the alert tuning: suggested changes to the log-query and rule semantics — put here so Ben can make a PR: 
````
// before: match /error|exception|panic/i over all logs
// after: only match when HTTP status >= 500 OR stacktrace present
(query) service:inference-worker AND (http.status_code:[500 TO 599] OR message:/stack|trace|panic/i)
aggregation: count() by minute > 50 for 5m
window: 5m
````
Also add a filter to exclude known transient messages: message NOT /connection reset by peer|client closed connection|upstream closed connection/i
Ben (monitoring): That looks good. Additionally recommend bumping the threshold from 50->75 for now to reduce noisy pages while we complete mitigations, and enable a 3m suppression if a page was acknowledged in last 10m.
Morgan (oncall): agree. We want to avoid missing real incidents though — keep a secondary low-priority alert for developer channels (non-pager).
Ava (SRE): I'll open the quick PR to update the alert rule and add the regex signature for 'retry-after flood' so it surfaces as a named signature in dashboard. PR: #infra/alerts/324 — assigning to Ben for review.
Ben (monitoring): Reviewing now. I'll also add a small dashboard tile (errors by message signature) so we can spot regressions.
Raj (infra): Ingress throttle applied. Initial metrics show error rate dropping back to baseline within 2m.
Elena (platform): Circuit-breaker closed over to fallback model for 8% of traffic — end-to-end latency stable.
Morgan (oncall): customer impact status: minor customer-facing retries, no sustained outage. We should notify support to prepare potential tickets.
Ava (SRE): Notifying support now. Message: "Heads-up: short-lived spike of 5xx in us-west1 for inference; mitigated with throttle and fallback. If customers see errors, they will be transient." :loudspeaker:
Sam (eng-sre): post-incident follow-ups:
- add the new regex signature to persistent rules and unit tests, owner Ben
- create an alert runbook entry for retry amplification and ingress throttling, owner Morgan
- instrument a dashboard with per-model error signatures and a 1h trend, owner Sam
- schedule a short postmortem tomorrow, assign to Ava
Morgan (oncall): tracking in #incidents-postmortems. I'll mark the incident as 'mitigated' and set severity to SEV3.
incidents-bot: Incident 1819456789 status -> mitigated at 1819457130. Follow-up tasks created: #324, dashboard tile, postmortem.
Ben (monitoring): PR merged. Alert updated with regex exclude and tightened query. Threshold bumped to 75 with a lower-priority non-pager signal kept at 50.
Ava (SRE): thanks all. We'll review the rule in the postmortem and consider long-term fixes (better backpressure in client SDKs, more robust retries).
Morgan (oncall): closing thread — will open postmortem doc with timeline. :white_check_mark:
